segments.ja: ジークの記憶は、戦場ではなく芝生から始まります。始まる相手は、クサヴァーです。クサヴァーは獣の巨人を継ぐ研究者で、少年とボールを投げ合います。投げ合う時間は、戦士の訓練より短いです。短い時間が、ジークには本物の午後になります。本物の午後を、父と母は計画の邪魔とは呼びません。呼ばない理由は、まだこの芝生を知らないからです。知らない芝生が、後で兄の計画の中心になります。
segments.en: Zeke's memory begins on grass, not on a battlefield. The person it begins with is Ksaver. Ksaver is the researcher who inherits the Beast Titan, and he throws a ball with the boy. The time they throw it is shorter than a warrior's training. For Zeke, the short time becomes a real afternoon. His father and mother do not call the real afternoon a nuisance to the plan. The reason they do not call it that is that they do not yet know this grass. The grass they do not know later becomes the center of the older brother's plan.

segments.ja: グリシャとダイナは、復元を信じる夫妻です。信じる内容は、エルディアの民が壁の外で再び立つ、です。立つために、彼らは息子をマーレの戦士候補に入れます。入れる役割は、いつか始祖へ届く内側の人間です。人間であることを、少年は愛だと思って受け取ります。受け取る宿題は、成績と、忠誠のふりと、親の合言葉です。合言葉は、家の中でだけ本物になります。
segments.en: Grisha and Dina are a couple who believe in restoration. What they believe is that the people of Eldia will stand again outside the walls. To make that standing happen, they put their son among Marley's warrior candidates. The role they put him in is an inside person who will one day reach the Founder. The boy receives being that person as love. The homework he receives is grades, a performance of loyalty, and his parents' password. The password becomes real only inside the house.

segments.en: Zeke cannot become the weapon his parents demand. The reason he cannot is not only a lack of talent. It is not. The weight of expectation reaches his body ahead of the afternoon of the ball. He drops the expectation that comes, in front of Marley's instructors. Grisha sees the face that drops it as disappointment. The disappointment he sees quiets the table at home. At the quiet table, Dina is still looking for the next password.

segments.en: Ksaver has already lost his own family. After the loss, he remains on the side that studies Eldian bodies. The study that remains is the years of a Titan and the rules of blood. He does not hand those rules to the boy as tactics. In place of handing them over, he continues the game of catch. The reason he continues is that this child is about to be crushed by his parents' plan. To the child about to be crushed, he shows a little of his own loss.

segments.ja: ジークは、グリシャをすべての原因として置きます。置く原因は、子供を復権の道具にした、です。にした痛みを、彼はエレンも共有するはずだと考えます。考える共有は、島で父に訓練された弟の記憶です。記憶が似ていれば、安楽死に同意する、と彼は見ます。見る同意は、まだ言葉になっていません。なっていない沈黙を、ジークは理解の始まりにします。始まりだと思っているあいだ、エレンは父の顔を別の角度で見ています。
segments.en: Zeke places Grisha as the cause of everything. The cause he places is that the father made a child into a tool of restoration. He thinks the younger brother must share the pain of that making. The sharing he thinks of is the memory of a younger brother trained by his father on the island. If the memories are alike, he expects agreement with euthanasia. The agreement he expects has not yet become words. He makes the silence that has not become words into the start of understanding. While he thinks it is the start, Eren is looking at the father's face from another angle.

segments.ja: 始祖が大きく動くには、王家の血が要ります。要る血を、ジークはダイナから受け取っています。受け取っている自分を、彼は鍵だと言います。言う鍵の向こうに、不戦の誓いがあります。誓いがあるため、王家の子孫は始祖を戦争へ向けられません。向けられない壁を、クサヴァーは研究で知っていました。知っていた壁を、ジークは安楽死なら越えられると考えます。考える根拠は、殺すためではなく、生まれないようにするため、です。
segments.en: For the Founder to move in a large way, royal blood is required. The blood that is required is what Zeke received from Dina. He calls the self that received it a key. Beyond the key he names, there is a vow to renounce war. Because the vow is there, a descendant of the royal family cannot aim the Founder at a war. Ksaver knew the wall that cannot be aimed, through his research. Zeke thinks that wall can be crossed if the aim is euthanasia. The ground of the thought is that it is not for killing. It is for not being born.

segments.titleJa: ユミルはまだ命令できない
segments.ja: 記憶の奥に、ユミルの名があります。ある名は、始祖の始まりとして語られます。語られるユミルを、ジークはまだ人としては見ていません。見ていない理由は、王家の命令に従う機能だと思っている、です。思っている機能に、安楽死を載せれば終わる、と彼は計算します。計算の外に、エレンが立っています。立っている弟は、ユミルを機能とは呼んでいません。呼ばないことが、この記憶の端の小さなずれです。
segments.en: Deep in the memory, there is the name of Ymir. The name that is there is told as the beginning of the Founder. Zeke does not yet see the Ymir who is told as a person. The reason he does not see her is that he thinks of a function that obeys royal orders. He calculates that it ends if euthanasia is loaded onto the function he thinks of. Eren is standing outside the calculation. The younger brother who is standing does not call Ymir a function. The not calling is a small gap at the edge of this memory.

segments.ja: マガトは、候補を扱うマーレの士官です。士官の制度が、少年ジークを戦士の列へ置きました。置いた列の中で、密告は忠誠として処理されます。処理される少年は、クサヴァーのボールをまだ持っています。持っている忠誠は、マーレのものにはなり切りません。なり切らない心を、制度は兵器の継承で十分だとみなします。みなす記録が、後の獣の巨人です。巨人の中に、芝生の午後が残っています。残っている芝生を、弟はまだ知りません。
segments.en: Magath is a Marley officer who handles the candidates. The system of the officer placed the boy Zeke into the row of warriors. Inside the row it placed, the report of his parents is processed as loyalty. The boy who is processed still holds Ksaver's ball. The loyalty he holds never fully becomes Marley's. The system treats the heart that does not fully become it as enough, because a weapon was inherited. The record it treats is the later Beast Titan. Inside the Titan, the afternoon on the grass remains. The younger brother does not yet know the grass that remains.
